name: MarineRAG 1.0
description: MarineRAG 1.0 is a retrieval benchmark for multi-source marine professional texts: 746 labeled queries (743 Chinese, 3 English smoke tests) include document-level gold, combined with two-axis query classification (intention × evidence channel), key points of the gold answer (3,077), chunk-level evidence locators, 923 corpora lists (including checksums), cleaning protocols, evaluation scripts, and the frozen result files behind each table in the paper. Due to copyright restrictions, the full text of 923 corpora and verbatim evidence citations are not distributed along with the package: with the list and the 1,000-character chunking rule for freezing, 59,860 chunks of the published 59,860 chunks can be reproduced. The corpora and citations can be provided upon reasonable request, for non-commercial research purposes only.
